# Launchpad contract: module, precompile 0x1017, Solidity contracts and tooling

## Scope and reading guide

The native [launchpad module](../../../modules/launchpad) and [precompile at `0x1017`](../../../precompiles/launchpad) serve the launchpad role surfaces. [Solidity contracts](../../../contracts/launchpad/contracts) and [deployment scripts](../../../contracts/launchpad/scripts) provide contract integration. Off-chain services are described in [services](services.md), and client interfaces in [clients](clients.md).

### Surface summary

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  PC["0x1017 launchpad precompile"] --> K["modules/launchpad keeper"]
  LEG["v6.10 legacy surface"] --> K
  SOL["contracts/launchpad Solidity"] --> PC
  TOOLS["tools/launchpad scripts"] --> SOL
  K --> GEN["genesis and params"]
```

## Launchpad module

The native launchpad module is `modules/launchpad`; `LaunchpadAddress` is `0x1017` in [keys.go](../../../modules/launchpad/types/keys.go). Keeper, query, CLI, genesis, params, store, events and error codes follow.

|---|---|
| interface | Keeper of modules/launchpad/keeper serving the generation 2 role surfaces, the Msg service and the Querier |
| storage | ParamsKey and the market, surface, role and fee-right prefixes of modules/launchpad/types/keys.go; generation 1 prefixes 0x03 and 0x20-0x25 stay reserved and empty |
| errors | sdk errors registered at modules/launchpad/types/errors.go |
| events | Cosmos events of modules/launchpad/types/events.go and the EVM logs of the EventEmitter role |
| gas | Precompile gas of the launchpad executor; keeper reads charge KV gas |
| activation | v6.12.0 migration MigrateV6120 refuses any pre-existing native market through CheckNoNativeMarkets |
| invariants | No generation 1 airdrop, holding or protocol-fee key exists after the migration |
| pause | Market pause of the pool role refuses trades; views and queries always answer |

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| interface | paxprotocol.paxchain.launchpad.Query service of api/launchpad/query.proto with 17 RPCs served by keeper.NewQuerier and mounted under /pax-protocol/paxchain/launchpad/ by the gateway |
| storage | Read-only over the launchpad store prefixes of modules/launchpad/types/keys.go; no query writes state |
| errors | ErrUnknownMarket code 12, ErrInvalidRange code 30 and ErrInvalidAirdropEpoch code 27 of modules/launchpad/types/errors.go; malformed addresses refused with codes.InvalidArgument |
| events | None |
| gas | Ordinary gRPC query gas metered by the query context |
| activation | Served from the binary that registers the Query server in RegisterServices; no store migration and ConsensusVersion stays 1 |
| invariants | Every query answer equals the precompile view of the same state; page limits are bounded at 100 |
| pause | Queries answer while markets are paused |

## Launchpad precompile 0x1017

The [precompile version registry](../../../precompiles/launchpad/setup.go) registers the current surface under `v6.12.0` and the supplied `latestUpgrade` key, and the legacy surface under `v6.10`. Gas and pause behavior follow the selected executor.

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| interface | Launchpad precompile at 0x1017 serving the twelve role ABIs under precompiles/launchpad/abi and the direct ABI precompiles/launchpad/abi.json |
| storage | Through the keeper only |
| errors | Contract custom errors returned by contractRevertData for the direct roles |
| events | Sixteen events of the direct ABI |
| gas | Per-method gas of the launchpad executor |
| activation | Served versions listed in the precompile versions file |
| invariants | The keeper satisfies PoolKeeper at compile time and the surface runtime has one definition |
| pause | Pool pause refuses trades; views always answer |

## Launchpad contract tooling and operations

Deployment, release and health scripts and deployment manifests of `contracts/launchpad`.

### launchpad-contracts-operations

| Interface | Kind | Source | Signature |
|---|---|---|---|
| <code>ts-lp-contracts-native-surface-j28</code> | <code>ts_export</code> | [contracts/launchpad/scripts/lib/native-surface.js](../../../contracts/launchpad/scripts/lib/native-surface.js) | <code>module.exports = { NATIVE_SURFACE_RUNTIME, isNativeSurface(code) }</code> |
| <code>ts-lp-contracts-plan-creation-fee-j28</code> | <code>ts_export</code> | [contracts/launchpad/scripts/set-creation-fee.js](../../../contracts/launchpad/scripts/set-creation-fee.js) | <code>module.exports = { planCreationFee({ code, fee, authority }) }</code> |

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| interface | Operator scripts of contracts/launchpad/scripts: production health, upgrade preflight and set-creation-fee |
| storage | None |
| errors | Preflight refuses native surfaces; set-creation-fee emits a governance message for them |
| events | None |
| gas | Not applicable |
| activation | Applies whenever a manifest proxy address holds the native surface runtime |
| invariants | No script sends a UUPS upgrade or an admin call to a native surface |
| pause | Not applicable |
